IGUI_SilencerMoon_RestoreExplain: Do this before removing SilencerMoon from the server. While it is on nobody can attach a SilencerMoon suppressor and the server takes it off every weapon, which gets its own range and damage back; the suppressor stays next to the weapon. It does so at once with the weapons of the players online and of the loaded vehicles, then every ten game minutes (also with whoever logs in later) and with containers, items on the ground and corpses as soon as their area loads. It stays on after a restart. Restart the server after turning it on: an area already loaded at that moment is checked only when it loads again. Keep it on until everyone has logged in at least once and the bases have been visited: a weapon that still has a suppressor when the mod is removed vanishes.
IGUI_SilencerMoon_RestoreConfirm: Turn the restore on? From now on nobody can attach a SilencerMoon suppressor and the server will take them off every weapon. Then restart the server.
